elements.label: Mouse cursor travelling to the Notion logo

pattern.description: Opening beat: on a bare off-white canvas with the centred Notion cube, a cursor enters from the lower left and glides diagonally up to rest on the logo's lower-right corner, setting up an interaction with it.
pattern.why_premium: A single smooth, decelerating cursor path on an otherwise empty frame directs the eye to the brand mark and signals 'this is a product you use', with no extra UI noise.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo(cursor, {x: -360, y: 260}, {x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) ending at the logo's lower-right corner; logo stays static.
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 21], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); cursor translate = lerp([-360, 260], [0, 0], p). A critically damped spring (damping ~26, stiffness ~120, no overshoot) also fits.

notes: Only the cursor moves; the logo looks static across the filmstrip. b01 (diff box around logo + cursor end) chosen for the cursor; b02 is the union of the cursor's travel path. Camera scale sum 0.709 is content-only (move none).
